title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: export de-identified user-level Copilot metrics
summary: The briefing promises that disabling dashboard auto-enablement leaves manually assigned and delegated access unchanged, but the Microsoft documentation checked does not state that behaviour. The rollout facts, export prerequisites, default state and feature-access policy commands are supported.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center route is Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, with Viva Insights and Copilot Metrics Export selected as the note instructs.
claims.quote: Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy. Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, the FeatureId returned by Get-VivaModuleFeature, Name, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy.
claims.quote:
Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone
The FeatureId value is returned in the output of the cmdlet.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center route is Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, selecting the Viva Insights web app feature as the note instructs.
claims.quote: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy. Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app for the tenant.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone
